reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year and my staff still abandoned it after two months, so paying ₹12,990 upfront for Docketra feels twice as expensive for a tool that might get dropped again. Even though I worry constantly about article clerks carrying client data on their laptops, I will stick to the free pilot before paying that kind of premium.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive, and will my staff abandon it just like past software?
would_change_my_mind: Proving during the free pilot that the Trainee Laptop Shield genuinely blocks clerks from downloading client data to personal laptops and that my team actually adopts it consistently.
